events.verdict: Ellis (SAC) appears to graze Beal's (PHX) arm during his shot attempt and the contact is marginal.
Sabonis (SAC) establishes himself in a screening position in Beal's (PHX) path and does not deliver contact.
Sabonis (SAC) has his arm extended when he makes contact to Beal's (PHX) arm, affecting his shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on O'Neale (PHX) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Although O'Neale initially makes contact with the ball, he follows through and initiates illegal contact to Sabonis's (SAC) face during his shot attempt near the rim.
Sabonis (SAC) extends his hands into Plumlee (PHX), illegally moving him off of his spot and affecting his ability to get to the rebound.
Booker (PHX) and Huerter (SAC) briefly engage and disengage on the perimeter.
Murray (SAC) makes contact with the ball after it exits the imaginary cylinder above the rim.

Murray (SAC) grabs Booker (PHX) during the throw-in, affecting his FOM. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul occurred prior to the ball being released and an away-from-the-play foul is assessed.
Ellis (SAC) establishes himself in Beal's (PHX) path and does not deliver contact.
Murray (SAC) jumps into Beal (PHX) as he attempts to secure the rebound, causing him to lose his balance.
Booker (PHX) gathers the ball with his right foot on the floor and legally takes one step before passing.
Jones (PHX) and Ellis (SAC) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Fox (SAC) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball.
Lyles (SAC) obtains a legal defensive position while guarding Booker (PHX) underneath the basket and the contact is incidental as Booker re-adjusts to attempt the layup.
Booker (PHX) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
The game is stopped due to a shot clock malfunction and play restarts with Sacramento retaining possession.
The shot clock expires while the Kings are still in possession of the ball.
